name: New Palace Bakery
summary: Family owned in Hamtramck since 1908 and self-described as Paczki Headquarters. Polish and European style baking: paczki, bread, cakes, cookies, pies, pastries, and wedding and birthday cakes. Paczki are sold year round, not only at Fat Tuesday.
hoursNote: Extended hours run in the days before Paczki Day. In 2026 the bakery opened at 3am on Fat Tuesday.
customCakeProcess: Wedding and birthday cakes are listed as a specialty. Call the bakery to discuss an order.
